predecessors.name: Kingdom of Thuringia
predecessors.text: the Thuringian kingdom conquered by the Franks in 531-532

successors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
successors.text: the whole duchy, ruled by Frankish dukes after Charles Martel

ledger.x: 567: Thuringia, under Frankish supreme rule since the Unstrut campaign of 531, appears as a Thuringian duchy in Cliopatria.

c. 631: King Dagobert I establishes the duchy of Thuringia and installs Radulf as its duke. 'It was established as a duchy about 631, by King Dagobert I'; Radulf was 'installed by King Dagobert in the early 630s' (ducal list 632-642). Radulf holds the Saale frontier against the Wends.
633: Cliopatria draws Thuringia as part of the Frankish kingdom for 633-640 while Radulf governs it as Dagobert's duke.

c. 641: Radulf rebels against King Sigebert III. 'About 641' Sigebert III marched against Radulf and his ally Fara, the Agilolfing; Fara was routed, but Radulf held his fortress on the Unstrut. Duchy page, after Fredegar: he rebelled against King Sigebert III in 641/2; Samo page: 'In 641, the rebellious Radulf sought…
641/2: Thuringia leaves direct Frankish rule under Radulf.
642: Radulf takes the title of king of Thuringia.
704: the ducal seat is at Würzburg on the Main.

c. 719: Charles Martel ends Thuringian autonomy. 'A conflict with Charles Martel around 717-19 brought an end to autonomy'; Heden II is the last duke on the list (689-719). Cliopatria keeps the shape to 723 and gives the land to the Franks in 724; the Hedan II page has Hedan rule to 741.

wars.name: Samo's Wends against Frankish Thuringia
wars.outcome: After Samo beat Dagobert I at Wogastisburg ('in 631 or 632') the Sorbs under Dervan joined him and he 'invaded Frankish Thuringia several times and undertook looting raids there'; Dervan's wars are dated 'successfully fighting against Frankish Thuringia…

wars.name: Radulf's revolt against Sigebert III
wars.outcome: Sigebert III's expedition failed (Fara's troops were routed and Fara killed, but Radulf held his fortress); in 642 Radulf defeated the king's army and took the title of king of Thuringia.

wars.name: Conflict with Charles Martel
wars.outcome: 'A conflict with Charles Martel around 717-19 brought an end to autonomy.'

certainty.note: No treaty line on the pages opened.
